label: Button-Down 7.8 cm Stand
description: The Button-Down collar at 7.8cm stand is the quintessential American shirt collar, featuring small buttons at each point that fasten to the shirt front to maintain the signature soft roll over a tie knot. This rolling of the collar creates a casual, lived-in elegance that is the calling card of Oxford Cloth Button-Down shirts and Ivy League dressing. Without a tie it produces a natural, unfussy frame for the neck that works from weekend brunches to smart casual office environments.
